issues.explanation: Chapter 54 says the wedding night has already begun and Liu Bei enters the bridal chamber, while Chapter 55 then says that after the weapons are removed Liu Bei and Sun夫人 subsequently marry. In the source, the chamber scene precedes the marriage that same night.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the Chapter 54 summary to say that Liu Bei is led into the bridal chamber and discovers the weapons, without calling it the wedding night or implying the marriage has already occurred.
